title: Every Page Already Known
story:
An author spent months writing a novel.

Before anyone read the first chapter, the final chapter had already been written.

One day, his young daughter picked up the book.

She read the opening pages and became worried.

“The main character is facing so many problems,” she said.

“Will everything be alright?”

Her father smiled.

“I already know how the story ends.”

“You only see one chapter.

I have written the whole book.”

The daughter continued reading with peace, trusting her father's words.

In life, we often see only today's chapter.

We don't know what tomorrow holds.

But God sees every page of our lives.

Before we were born, He knew every day we would live.

Nothing surprises Him.

As we trust the Author of our lives, we can move forward with confidence, knowing His plan is good.
life_lesson: God already knows every chapter of your life. Trust the Author who lovingly wrote your story.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for knowing my life from beginning to end.

When I cannot understand today's chapter, help me trust Your perfect plan.

Give me peace, knowing that every day is in Your hands.

May I walk faithfully with You, one day at a time.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you anxious because you cannot see what lies ahead?

How does knowing that God already knows every day of your life encourage you?

What is one area where you can trust His plan today?
